title: Crispi Soft Cheddar Grits Squares with Chive-Butter Sauce
description: Chilled cheddar grits warm through in milk and finish as soft squares in a smooth paprika and chive-butter sauce.
equipment: Ninja Crispi PowerPod with US Bake preset and 6-cup glass container

ingredients.name: plain quick-cooking grits
ingredients.note: Use quick grits labeled for about 5–8 minutes, without seasoning.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: Divide between the dish, grits and sauce.

steps.title: Cook the grits
steps.text: Bring {water_grits} and {milk_grits} to a simmer in a saucepan. Gradually whisk in {grits}, reduce the heat to low and stir for 5–8 minutes, until the grains are tender and the mixture holds a mound.

steps.title: Set the cheese base
steps.text: Use a little {butter} to grease a small shallow dish. Fold {cheddar} and half the remaining butter into the hot grits until smooth and spread the grits in the dish.

steps.title: Chill until sliceable
steps.text: Let steam escape for 5 minutes, then refrigerate the shallow slab for at least 55 minutes, until it is firm enough to slice cleanly.

steps.title: Set up the Crispi
steps.text: Use the room-temperature 6-cup Ninja glass container without its crisper plate or an adapter. Leave off the storage lid. Load the container before starting the PowerPod.

steps.title: Braise the squares in milk
steps.text: Cut the cold grits into two squares per serving and lay them in the unheated Crispi glass with {milk_sauce}. Spoon milk over the tops. Seat the PowerPod and select Bake.

steps.title: Check the center
steps.text: After 8 minutes, baste the squares with warm milk using a silicone spoon. Continue for another 5–12 minutes, until the coldest center reaches 165°F. Lift gently into warm shallow bowls.

steps.title: Infuse the sauce
steps.text: Ladle the hot cooking milk into the HexClad with {chives} and {paprika} and bring to a gentle simmer for 1 minute.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and let it bubble for 1 minute, stirring until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish with butter
steps.text: Swirl in the remaining reserved butter off heat. Pour the sauce over and around the soft squares.

notes: Make ahead: Set the slab in the refrigerator the night before. The 72-minute preparation estimate includes 60 minutes for cooling and chilling. Keep finished portions refrigerated for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze individual portions with sauce for up to 1 month. The grits may soften into spoonfuls on reheating. Fridge reheat: Warm a single portion, covered, in the HexClad with a splash of broth or water. Stir or turn gently and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Use the same covered reheating method and heat the center to 165°F. For dairy-free grits, use plain unsweetened oat milk in both stages, a mild dairy-free cheddar that melts and unsalted plant-based butter. Finely minced parsley may replace chives. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 322 kcal, 10.4 g protein, 33.7 g total carbohydrate, 16.0 g fat, 1.5 g fiber, 164 mg sodium.
